svg.text: 25.4 x 48.26 mm envelope | top view | +Y towards USB

circle.title: J1_2: RST | High: Power up; Low: Power down., RST
J1_3: 2 | GPIO2, LP_GPIO2, LP_UART_RTSN, ADC1_CH2, FSPIQ
J1_5: 4 | MTMS, GPIO4, LP_GPIO4, LP_UART_RXD, ADC1_CH4, FSPIHD, Boot strapping pin; external levels affect startup.
J1_6: 5 | MTDI, GPIO5, LP_GPIO5, LP_UART_TXD, ADC1_CH5, FSPIWP, Boot strapping pin; external levels affect startup.
J1_7: 0/N | GPIO0, XTAL_32K_P, LP_GPIO0, LP_UART_DTRN, ADC1_CH0
J1_8: 1/N | GPIO1, XTAL_32K_N, LP_GPIO1, LP_UART_DSRN, ADC1_CH1
J1_9: 8 | GPIO8, Boot strapping pin; external levels affect startup., Shared onboard net: addressable_rgb_led
J1_10: 6 | MTCK, GPIO6, LP_GPIO6, LP_I2C_SDA, ADC1_CH6, FSPICLK
J1_11: 7 | MTDO, GPIO7, LP_GPIO7, LP_I2C_SCL, FSPID
J3_10: 15 | GPIO15, Boot strapping pin; external levels affect startup.
J3_11: 9 | GPIO9, Boot strapping pin; external levels affect startup.
J3_13: 13 | GPIO13, USB_D+, USB D-/D+ function: GPIO use can disconnect native USB; check board routing.
J3_14: 12 | GPIO12, USB_D-, USB D-/D+ function: GPIO use can disconnect native USB; check board routing.
